children: Overview
France semiconductor equipment maker's H1 2026 revenue grew 19% yr/yr to €12.7 mln
Net income turned positive at €0.2 mln, compared with a loss in H1 2025
Company secured €6 mln financing to accelerate industrialization of ROSIE II platform
Outlook
RIBER expects 2026 revenues to be broadly in line with 2025, subject to export license approval
Company says first BTO/STO samples from ROSIE II will be available in Q4 2026
RIBER sees sustained demand in photonics, AI, quantum technologies and Services and Accessories
Result Drivers
SERVICES AND ACCESSORIES MOMENTUM - Co said 71% growth in Services and Accessories revenue drove overall performance
HIGHER GROSS MARGIN RATE - Co attributed improved profitability to increased gross margin rate and disciplined expense management
EXPORT RESTRICTIONS IMPACT - Co said order book was affected by export restrictions to Asia, preventing over €8 mln in orders
